request.style: English, children's song, bright children's choir, ukulele, glockenspiel, hand claps, shaker, bouncy bass, playful counting sing-along, 116 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Love says I will share my bread
Joy goes jumping on ahead
Peace sits quiet, calm and still
Patience waits and always will

[Chorus]
The fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace
Patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness
Gentleness, self-control
Against such things there is no law

[Verse]
Kindness helps a friend who falls
Goodness does what is right for all
Faithful keeps the words it said
Gentle tucks the lamb in bed
Self-control says stop and wait
Take a breath and count to eight

[Chorus]
The fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace
Patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness
Gentleness, self-control
Against such things there is no law

[Bridge]
Nine little fruits on the Spirit tree
Growing in you and growing in me
One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine
Growing in you and growing in me

[Chorus]
The fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace
Patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness
Gentleness, self-control
Against such things there is no law

[Outro]
Love, joy, peace
Patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness
Gentleness, self-control
